title: Core 007 tree silhouette and branch-gap comparison
alt_text: A controlled diagram uses one tree photo in tall and wide crops. The tall crop shows the outside contour; the wide line study has broad branch lines, two short open marks along observed branch edges, and one canopy correction beside its earlier guide.
caption: Use the tall crop to simplify the outside shape. In the wide crop, let two open branch gaps check the contour.
